snippet.title: Trash Heart [Trailer]
snippet.description:
Explore Trash Heart, a planet in the iron grip of the Trash Lord. Find artefacts that grant powerful abilities, fight hordes of deadly foes, and save a planet of outcast robots. Or just scrounge up all the trash your grubby little raccoon hands can hold.
Coming 2026.

Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1877260/Trash_Heart/
